title: Explain how the shirt was made

scenario.en: A younger student asks you to explain the article about how a shirt is made.
scenario.ar: طالب أصغر منك طلب تشرحله المقال عن إزاي القميص بيتعمل.

source: The article said: cotton is grown in a warm country and cleaned in a factory, then it is turned into thread. The thread is dyed before it is woven. The cloth is exported to a second factory, where it is cut and sewn. The buttons are added by hand, and each shirt is checked before it is packed.

task.en: Relay the main stages of the process in order.

key_points.en: Cotton is grown and cleaned, then turned into thread.
key_points.ar: القطن بيُزرع ويتنضف وبعدين يبقى خيط.

key_points.en: The thread is dyed before it is woven.
The cloth is exported, cut and sewn in a second factory.
key_points.ar: القماش بيتصدّر ويتقص ويتخيّط في مصنع تاني.

key_points.en: The buttons are added by hand and each shirt is checked.
key_points.ar: الزراير بتتحط باليد وكل قميص بيتفحص.

model_answer.en: First the cotton is grown and cleaned, then it is turned into thread. The thread is dyed before it is woven. The cloth is exported to a second factory, where it is cut and sewn. Finally the buttons are added by hand, and each shirt is checked before it is packed.
model_answer.ar: الأول القطن بيُزرع ويتنضف، وبعدين يبقى خيط. والخيط بيتصبغ قبل ما يُنسج. والقماش بيتصدّر لمصنع تاني، وهناك يتقص ويتخيّط. وفي الآخر الزراير بتتحط باليد وكل قميص بيتفحص.
